frames.spoken: Purity Beans Ultra Blend is 70% coffee and 30% chicory, blended specifically for a smooth milk coffee.
We do not hide the ratio. It is printed plainly on the label for you to see.
This specific blend is crafted for the classic Indian milk-coffee cup, delivering a rounded taste that holds up to milk.
While Ultra Blend is our milk-coffee specialist, our other ranges are pure coffee with zero chicory.
Choose Ultra Blend for milk, or our pure range for black. Visit p3online.in to find your match.
At about ₹5 a cup, Purity Beans Ultra Blend delivers a premium, honest experience for your daily routine.

reels.body: Purity Beans Ultra Blend is a smooth 70% coffee, 30% chicory milk coffee, labelled plainly. Purity Beans — Bold, Purista, Purica, and Prima list coffee only.
reels.caption: Why is Purity Beans Ultra Blend 70% coffee and 30% chicory? The reason is milk: this specific blend creates a smooth, rounded milk coffee that holds its flavor. Read the label and you will see the ratio printed plainly. That is the difference between a transparent blend and a guess. At about ₹5 a cup, Purity Beans Ultra Blend offers a premium, honest experience for your daily routine. Follow @purepantryprovisions for daily coffee know-how and label-reading tips. Shop at https://p3online.in

editorial_score.feedback: The hook '70/30, ON PURPOSE' is elite and stops the scroll, but the asset fails on retention. Frame 4 introduces a list of four other products (Bold, Purista, Purica, Prima), which creates a cognitive load spike and kills the momentum of the 'Ultra Blend' story. The transition from a specific blend's purpose to a general brand catalog is too abrupt. To fix: remove the specific product list in the script and replace it with 'Our other ranges are 100% pure coffee' to keep the focus on transparency. Additionally, the provided visual prompt is truncated and incomplete.
editorial_score.retention_audit: Frame 4: 'While Ultra Blend is our milk-coffee specialist, the rest of the Purity Beans range is pure coffee' is a momentum killer. It shifts from a specific product benefit to a general brand statement too quickly. Replace with a punchier bridge like 'Prefer it black? Our pure range has you covered.'

editorial_score.feedback: The betrayal hook ('30% chicory this whole time') lands instantly and the radical transparency payoff (label proof → purpose → contrast) builds high trust. Attention dip at Frame 4: listing Bold, Purista, Purica in one spoken line without visual separation causes a micro-drop. Fix: split into two frames — Frame 4a 'BOLD = PURE ROBUSTA' with jar visual, Frame 4b 'PURISTA & PURICA = PURE ARABICA' — or add a quick on-screen bullet list as each name is spoken. Caption's 'Read the jar' closer is strong but 'how do you take yours?' comment trigger is generic; swap for 'Comment MILK or BLACK — I'll tell you which jar fits.' That turns comments into qualified leads.
editorial_score.retention_audit: Frame 1-3: Strong retention — label proof, purpose, cup math. Frame 4: Attention dip — four SKUs in one breath, no visual anchor. Frame 5: Recovery — clear C

facebook_post.hook: Ever notice how the kitchen smells like a bakery the moment you twist open a jar of Purica before the water even heats?
facebook_post.body: Purity Beans Purica is freeze-dried pure Arabica with zero chicory, and that caramel-chocolate aroma hits different because freeze-drying locks in what other methods lose. The 50g jar is ₹329 and the 100g is ₹559, with free shipping on orders over ₹399. It comes in a food-grade glass jar so nothing leaches into your cup. Bold is our agglomerated pure coffee for a heavier kick, Purista is freeze-dried Robusta for crema lovers, and Ultra Blend is 70% coffee with 30% chicory for everyday milk cups. I reach for Purica when the morning asks for something smooth and deliberate rather than just strong, and that first sip carries the same caramel-chocolate promise the jar made.

threads_post.text:
Purica by Purity Beans is freeze-dried pure Arabica — smooth, caramel and chocolatey notes that taste like a cafe cup. Robusta hits different: more caffeine, more bitterness, heavier body.

If you could only drink one forever: Purica's aromatic Arabica or Robusta's bold kick?

Comment your pick. Follow for one honest coffee question daily.
https://p3online.in
threads_post.visual_description: A high-resolution, vertical shot of the Purica Gourmet Arabica jar on a dark marble surface. Soft gold accent lighting hits the label. A few freeze-dried granules are scattered naturally next to the jar. Shallow depth of field, shot on 85mm lens, realistic skin texture on a hand partially visible, reaching for the jar.

cues.cue: About ten seconds, beats near two seconds, two moods that resolve before the end.
Vertical 1080x1920 with the featured jar forward so the glass and label stay readable.
Two moods. A single jar shows two moods of that jar. A duo shows its own two jars. Do not swap in the Gourmet Duo Mini pair.
Warm editorial glass-jar photography. The jar is the hero. Not a poster turned into a video.

scenes.on_screen: Extreme close-up of Purity Beans Purica jar label. Finger traces '0% chicory' and 'freeze-dried Arabica'. Dark background, warm amber light on glass.
scenes.spoken: What is actually inside your instant coffee jar?
scenes.visual_direction: Handheld macro, shallow depth of field. Label texture catches light. Slow push in.

scenes.on_screen: Split frame: left side — generic instant coffee powder clumping, dark murky liquid. Right side — Purica granules dissolving clean, amber clarity. Same spoon, same water.
scenes.spoken: Most instant coffee hides chicory and fillers. Purica is pure Arabica, freeze-dried to lock aroma.
scenes.visual_direction: Locked-off, side-by-side comparison. Steam rises naturally. No text overlay needed.

scenes.on_screen: Pour-over style: hot water hits Purica granules in a glass server. Creamy crema forms. Cut to sip — relaxed exhale, genuine satisfaction.
scenes.spoken: Freeze-drying keeps the oils. You taste caramel, chocolate, no bitter aftertaste.
scenes.visual_direction: Slow motion pour, 120fps. Crema close-up. Real sip, not acted.

scenes.on_screen: Jar on kitchen counter. Morning light. Label readable: 'Purica Gourmet Arabica Granules — Pure Arabica — 0% Chicory — Freeze-Dried'.
scenes.spoken: Read the jar. Purity Beans puts it in writing.
scenes.visual_direction: Static, cinematic. Dust motes in light. Lived-in kitchen — used spoon, crumpled napkin.

scenes.on_screen: Phone screen recording: thumb taps 'Add to Cart' on p3online.in/products/purica. URL visible. Jar beside phone.
scenes.spoken: Purica, 50g or 100g. https://p3online.in. Pure coffee, nothing added.
scenes.visual_direction: POV phone view. Thumb slightly imperfect. Natural screen glare.

scenes.on_screen: Purity Beans logo subtle on jar cap. Text: 'Follow for label checks that save you money.'
scenes.spoken: Follow Purity Beans. Next short: why freeze-dried changes everything.
scenes.visual_direction: Slow pull back. Jar stays hero. Warm tone holds.
